intent.proves: No item-based paragraph lacks its item instance.
intent.scope: non-deleted paragraphs with an item type; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(ParagraphId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ParagraphItemType FROM Paragraph WHERE ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(ParagraphItemType, N'') <> N'' AND ISNULL(ParagraphItemId, N'') = N''
